Class ResourceTypeClientImpl

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.core.client.ClientBase
com.eqixiac.equinix.iam.client.internal.implementation.ResourceTypeClientImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
ResourceTypeClient
public class ResourceTypeClientImpl extends ClientBase implements ResourceTypeClient
Internal client implementation for the IAM access-model discovery operations. The list-shaped responses are read-only and use opaque-token (nextPageToken) pagination rather than the core's offset-based paging, so the deserialized list models are returned directly; callers fetch subsequent pages by passing getNextPageToken() back as the pageToken argument.
